causes: Real powf evaluation silently returned NaN for negative bases with noninteger exponents. complex(float(expr)) then produced nan+0j, falsely giving mixed quartic spectra four apparently real roots.
Matrix.eigenvalues wrapped native arithmetic directly, while polynomial roots used canonical result lifting, producing structurally inconsistent exact spectra from the same checked root engine.
corrections: Refuse negative real bases with finite noninteger exponents, and negative real sqrt/log arguments, using the existing not-real-valued error path. Existing complex evaluation then handles the principal branch. Explicit NaN, infinities and real-valued boundary behavior are retained.
Use _lift_native_result for native matrix eigenvalues, preserving the existing checked characteristic polynomial, completeness, multiplicity and fallback rules.
